name: fg-listing-triage
description: Triage an on-market DC-metro listing for FRESH GROUND teardown-lot wholesaling: pursue, watch, or skip.

action.instructions: Count the motivation signals in `pct_below_original_ask`, `dead_contracts`, `seller_financing` and `dom_days`, then pick the label whose rule matches.

criteria.pursue: Land or teardown lot AND at least two of these: `pct_below_original_ask` 20 or more, `dead_contracts` 1 or more, `seller_financing` yes, `dom_days` over 200.
criteria.watch: Land or teardown lot with at most one of those four signals (zero or one).
criteria.skip: A finished house sold as a normal resale; `days_since_first_listed` under 30; a lot described as a remnant or unbuildable; or anything that is not a land or teardown opportunity.

motivated_seller.instructions: Is the seller under pressure to sell? Count the signals: `pct_below_original_ask` 20 or more, `dead_contracts` 1 or more, `seller_financing` yes, `dom_days` over 200. Two or more signals = yes. Zero signals = no. Exactly one signal = lean yes only if `listing_notes` also shows pressure (price cuts, 'motivated', 'bring all offers', estate sale).
